name: Lake Lure Adventure Company
hours: In season (Memorial Day–Labor Day): Monday–Sunday, 9 AM–8 PM. Off season (September–April): call for availability.
priceNotes: Fuel is included in the price. Rates exclude tax and holiday weeks/weekends. Free Yeti cooler with any pontoon or ski boat rental.

rateCards.label: Mastercraft ski boat with driver/instructor (up to 8 guests)

insiderNote: Beer and wine are fine; no liquor. Not a public ramp, so leave your own boat, kayak or paddleboard at home. Tubing isn't allowed behind the pontoons; book a ski boat trip for tubing.
featuredNote: Locally owned and family run — a small business hit hard by Hurricane Helene. Fuel is included and every pontoon or ski boat rental comes with a free Yeti cooler.
highlights: Fuel included in the price; rates exclude tax and holiday weeks/weekends
Free Yeti cooler with any pontoon or ski boat rental; pool noodles come with pontoons
Pontoons for self-drive cruising, swimming and fishing (driver must be 21+ with a valid license and credit card; no boating license required)
Ski boat trips with USA Waterski certified staff: waterskiing, slalom, barefoot, tubing, kneeboarding, wakeboarding and wakesurfing (up to 8 people, Mastercraft Pro-Star 197 and X-2)
Mix and match activities in one session, such as skiing and tubing in the morning and a pontoon cruise in the afternoon
Kayak and paddleboard rentals delivered to Lake Lure lakefront homes (full-day rentals only)
Guided bass and fly fishing trips with guide Rob McComas (Monday–Friday)
Dog friendly to well-behaved dogs on pontoons, kayaks and paddleboards, with no pet fee
Free changes or cancellation 48 hours ahead; no charge if you skip a rental because of lightning, hail or heavy rain
reviewSummary: 4.8 of 5 across 134 Tripadvisor reviews, ranked #2 of 7 Boat Tours & Water Sports in Lake Lure. Reviewers describe clean, well-kept boats, friendly crews and flexible handling of weather changes. Notes from reviewers: parking is limited and there are no restrooms on site.

name: Lake Lure Boat Rental
priceNotes: Daily rentals include fuel. Rates exclude 7% tax and a 3.5% credit card fee (pay cash to skip the card fee). Holidays add $50 to hourly or $50 per day on multi-day rentals. Multi-day rentals meter fuel and charge $6/gallon.

rateCards.label: Daily rate — 9, 10 or 12 passenger pontoon (3-hour minimum at their 506 Memorial Hwy dock, 4-hour minimum for marina or lakefront delivery)
Multi-day, per day (fuel metered and billed at $6/gallon)

insiderNote: Renters must be 25. Delivery or pick-up at Washburn Marina, the Rumbling Bald public dock, a rental-home dock, or their own dock at 506 Memorial Hwy (2-vehicle limit). Pets welcome for a $25 clean-up fee. 5% military discount on hourly rentals ($50 off multi-day). Late arrival and late return fees apply, so be on time.

name: Rumbling Bald on Lake Lure
address: North Shore Beach Cabana, Rumbling Bald on Lake Lure (153 Mountains Blvd), Lake Lure, NC
priceNotes: Price includes the hourly rate and gas only; tax is extra. Rentals are for Rumbling Bald members and lodging guests only.

rateCards.label: Scenic Lake Lure cruise, per person (11 AM, 2 PM and 4 PM daily; about 1 hr 15 min)

insiderNote: For Rumbling Bald members and lodging guests only. Dogs allowed on rental pontoons at $10 per dog per rental hour. Rentals are for cruising only: no towing skiers or tubes, and no glass or hard liquor. Drivers must complete the Lake Lure Boater Safety Course, and NC requires it for anyone born after 1988. Life jackets, safety instructions and a lake map are included. Scenic cruises need 4 to 16 guests, a minimum of 4 passengers to depart, and arrival 15 minutes early; you may share the boat with other groups, and cruise reservations are non-refundable. For rental changes, contact the North Shore Beach Cabana at least 24 hours ahead or the reservation is non-refundable.

name: Good Time Boat Rentals
insiderNote: Fuel and taxes included in all rates; free delivery and pickup.
